newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Omnipoint upgraded to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Omnipoint upgraded to buy.

text.p: -- ABN AMRO Chicago Corp said Tuesday it upgraded its rating for Omnipoint Corp to buy from hold, citing significant immprovements in the personal communications services company's coverage and network quality in New York.

-- ABN AMRO analyst Kevin Roe said the digital commercial service that Omnipoint launched in New York City in November is improving after being plagued with problems in the important holiday selling season.
-- Roe said Omnipoint may now promote the service aggressively, which could help the stock recover the 40 percent of value it lost in the final months of 1996.
-- Omnipoint is a communications services provider. Its shares were off 1-11/16 Tuesday afternoon at 23-1/8.
